name: yahoo_japan_ads-mcp
display_name: LINEヤフー広告 (formerly Yahoo! JAPAN Ads) MCP
description: LINEヤフー広告 (formerly Yahoo! JAPAN Ads) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause

platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_client_id.description: Client ID of your approved LINEヤフー広告 API application (API管理ツール).

platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_refresh_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_refresh_tok.description: Refresh token from one authorization-code login with a Business ID (scope yahooads, https://ads-developers.yahoo.co.jp/ja/ads-api/startup-guide/api-call.html); valid until the user revokes the app. One-hour access tokens are minted from it.

platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_base_accoun.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_BASE_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_base_accoun.description: Account the Business ID directly holds rights on (MCC or ad account id from BaseAccountService/get), sent as the x-z-base-account-id header on every call.

platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_account_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_JAPAN_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
platform_mcp_yahoo_japan_ads_account_id.description: Search ad account id used by update_budget and pause_resume (CampaignService/set requires accountId in the body).

tools.name: me
tools.description: POST /BaseAccountService/get: the MCC and ad accounts the Business ID directly holds rights on.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: POST /BaseAccountService/get {numberResults: 200}: accounts the Business ID directly holds rights on (MCC accounts included; raw.account.authType shows the permission). Use an id as base_account_id / account_id.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /CampaignService/get {accountId, userStatuses: [status], startIndex, numberResults} with the x-z-base-account-id header. `status` is ACTIVE or PAUSED; `budget` is the daily budget (yen) of individually budgeted campaigns (shared budgets show raw.campaign.budget.campaignBudgetId). Only the first page is returned (Yahoo's startIndex is 1-based and the adapter's offset is 0-based, so it is not sent).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: POST /CampaignService/set {accountId (account_id config), operand: [{campaignId, budget: {amount}}]}: the daily budget in whole yen for an individually budgeted campaign (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Check operation_succeeded and errors in the result.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /CampaignService/set {accountId, operand: [{campaignId, userStatus: PAUSED|ACTIVE}]}. Resuming restarts spending. Check operation_succeeded.
